Anna trabalha numa agência de turismo há: Anna has worked at a travel agency for five years. Before, she wanted to be a journalist, but after university she did not find that kind of job. Although the salary at the agency is small, Anna likes talking with people and helping them choose trips. Thanks to this job, she has already been to ten countries. If she had more free time, she would write a book about her travels. Last week her boss said that a new office will open soon and that she will be offered the position of manager. Anna has not yet decided whether to accept. On the one hand, it is interesting and there will be more money; on the other hand, she will have to work a lot and there will be no time left for the book.
Дома или в офисе? / Em casa ou no escrit: Дома или в офисе? / At home or in the office?
— O que você acha: o trabalho remoto é m: — What do you think: is remote work better than working in an office?
— Na minha opinião é mais cômodo, porque: — In my opinion it is more convenient, because you don't have to waste time on the commute.
— É verdade, mas me parece que em casa é: — True, but it seems to me that it is hard to concentrate at home.
— Em parte você tem razão. Porém, se eu: — You are partly right. However, if I had a separate office, I would work at home every day.
— Não concordo totalmente. Preciso conve: — I don't fully agree. I need to talk with colleagues, otherwise I get tired of the loneliness.
— Então é melhor trabalhar em casa dois: — Then it's better to work at home two days a week and in the office on the other days.

O gerúndio exige o mesmo sujeito: «у мен: A gerund requires the same subject: «у меня» is not the subject of «читая»
Qual correção de «Я прочитал книгу два ч: Which correction of «Я прочитал книгу два часа» expresses only the duration of the reading, without stating that it was finished?
«Я читал книгу два часа» informa a duraç: «Я читал книгу два часа» gives the duration without saying that I finished. «Я прочитал книгу за два часа» is also correct, but it says that I finished the book in two hours; that is not the meaning asked for.
Usar o imperfectivo: «Я читал книгу два: Use the imperfective: «Я читал книгу два часа».
Usar o genitivo plural depois de «два»:: Use the genitive plural after «два»: «два часов».
Inserir «за»: «Я прочитал книгу за два ч: Insert «за»: «Я прочитал книгу за два часа».
Passiva com o particípio curto «построен: Passive with the short participle «построен», which agrees with «дом».
